name: Kaiterra
description:
Kaiterra monitors indoor environmental quality — air, temperature, humidity, light, and sound — in commercial buildings worldwide. This connector gives Claude direct access to your Kaiterra account so you can investigate your buildings in plain language instead of clicking through dashboards.

Explore your portfolio: list buildings, floors, spaces, and devices, and see live readings mapped onto floorplans.

Pull and compare data: fetch time series for PM2.5, CO₂, TVOC, temperature, humidity, sound, and light across multiple devices at once, and compare indoor conditions against outdoor air quality.

Diagnose problems: run a traffic-light health check on any building, detect statistical anomalies, and compare before-and-after periods to verify whether an HVAC change or renovation actually worked.

Track certification: check WELL compliance for any date range and see Time Within Targets for each metric.

Monitor HVAC and occupancy: review air flow rate, filter status, and CO₂-derived occupancy estimates.

Organize and alert: rename devices, assign them to spaces, create or update spaces and floors, and set up alert watches for any parameter — all from the conversation.

Requires a Kaiterra account with connected devices. Read access covers your building hierarchy and sensor data. Write access is limited to configuration: device names and placements, space and floor records, and alert watches. Claude cannot modify or delete historical sensor readings.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Kaiterra to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Kaiterra to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.kaiterra.com/ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Kaiterra MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kaiterra lists 27 MCP tools, including kaiterra_build_chart, kaiterra_building_health_check, kaiterra_compare_periods, kaiterra_create_space, kaiterra_create_watch, kaiterra_delete_watch, kaiterra_detect_anomalies, kaiterra_fetch_alert_history, kaiterra_fetch_hvac_metrics, kaiterra_fetch_occupancy, kaiterra_fetch_outdoor_air_quality, and kaiterra_fetch_series.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Kaiterra?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Kaiterra in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Kaiterra requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Kaiterra is developed by Kaiterra. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
